thread:
maya: Trying to reserve 40x A100s in us-west-2 for the finetune sprint, but the console shows 'pending org auth' and the reservation never completes. Anyone seen this today?
raj: hm no, I saw a couple auth flaps earlier but not for reservations. Can you paste the error or screenshot?
maya: here's the error from the cloud UI:
```
Reservation request: 40xA100
Status: PENDING_APPROVAL
Reason: pending org billing authorization (code: BILL_AUTH_REQUIRED)
Contact: billing@cloudvendor.com
```
oliver: cloud quota + billing auth combo. We hit a new commitment threshold yesterday which flipped the org to require PO approval for large committed capacity. Finance needs to clear it with the vendor.
finance-bot: [auto] Billing hold detected: org-level commitment change requires signed PO. Affected requests: resource-alloc-1742001111.
tia: hi — I see this on our side. We have a draft PO but legal flagged a clause. I can escalate to vendor CSM, but need the exact cost/term to finalize. maya can you paste the proposed reservation term?
maya: plan was 3 months reserved for the sprint, est cost ~ $92k/mo (list) before committed discount. If we get the 20% commitment discount it drops to ~ $73.6k/mo.
raj: short-term workaround: can we spare from the non-prod pool in us-west-2 for 2 weeks? We can set eviction/taint so prod traffic doesn't end up on them. Preemption risk but it buys time.
oliver: non-prod pool only has ~12 A100s available. Another option: spin transients in us-west-1 (same region family) and use smart routing to send training traffic there. Latency won't matter for batch finetune.
maya: us-west-1 would be fine for batch. Only concern is cross-region egress costs and model artifact sync.
tia: finance prefers vendor PO route; however, if you need capacity today, approved ad-hoc spotlight spend is possible up to $25k pending my sign-off. Beyond that we need the PO.
raj: if team agrees, we can split job across us-west-1 (24 GPUs) + borrow 12 from non-prod in us-west-2 and run staggered jobs. I'll add a short script to shard checkpoints.
maya: ok let's do that as plan A. oliver, can you open an escalation ticket with the vendor (include the PO draft) and cc tia? I'll kick off the cross-region allocation now.
oliver: opening ticket with cloud vendor CSM and support, referencing commitment hold + reservation request. tagging billing ops. ETA vendor ack: ~3-6 business hours. cc @tia
oncall-bot: escalation logged — ticket# CV-47291 created and assigned to vendor-csm.
maya: thanks all. I'll post updates in this thread once the jobs start or if we hit provisioning errors on cross-region nodes.
raj: noted — I'll be on standby for the sharding adjustments and will add a runbook for rollback if we get preemptions. :thumbsup:
